items.label: Material
items.value: Ladies Fashion Bag is made of high-quality PU leather (artificial synthetic leather). It feels comfortable, and the color is full and shiny. Metal chain bag and decorative buckle are fashionable, novel and beautiful. Ideal for traveling and carrying.

items.label: Structure and Size
items.value: Crocodile pattern crossbody bag (L9" x W3.1" x H5.5"). The magnetic opening and chain shoulder strap are easy to use and can be worn in a variety of ways. It can be cross-body, hand-carried and single-shoulder.

items.label: Simple Design
items.value: using the most popular patterns at the moment, sexy and beautiful full of high-level sense. Lined with 2 main pockets and compartment zipper pockets for easy storage and organization of items. Such as mobile phones, keys, sunglasses and cards.

items.label: Lovely Choice
items.value: classic retro style, stand upright body is not easy to deform. Comfortable, light and generous, it is very suitable for daily work, travel, parties and cocktail parties. It is also a perfect gift for lovers, friends and family.

items.label: Service
items.value: If you have any questions or suggestions about the product, we will solve it for you as soon as possible. Let every customer have a good shopping experience.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Wipe with a damp cloth. Avoid contact with harsh chemicals. Store in a cool, dry place.
